methodology.selection: Nearest generated tone independently for Light and Dark
methodology.alpha: Preserved from the Figma variable and excluded from color-distance comparison
semanticPolicy: Accents retain their authored family identity.
Apple Grays and neutral semantic colors map to the authored n.black.v2 family.
Figma aliases retain their target family.
Opaque Sidebar colors without aliases select the nearest source-backed family and remain candidate mappings.
